# Prompt

Why does retrieval practice improve later recall?

# Answer

Retrieving an answer strengthens access to it and exposes what the learner cannot yet recall.

# Hint

Contrast recall with rereading.

# Follow-up challenge

Name one way to keep retrieval practice honest.
